2026-10-09PS, EMCREmergency Management ActProvincial Emergency Financial Assistance Order No. 288, OntarioProvincial Emergency Financial Assistance Order No. 288 in order to (1) declare the natural disaster to be of concern to the federal government; and (2) authorize the provision of financial assistance to the province of Ontario with respect to the ice storm that occurred in Ontario, from March 28 to March 30, 2025.N/A
subject: Provincial Emergency Financial Assistance Order No. 288, Ontario
precis: Provincial Emergency Financial Assistance Order No. 288 in order to (1) declare the natural disaster to be of concern to the federal government; and (2) authorize the provision of financial assistance to the province of Ontario with respect to the ice storm that occurred in Ontario, from March 28 to March 30, 2025.
